description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: In the AMD AI Group we're optimizing the ROCm software stack for AI graph execution and latency-sensitive dispatch. We are building next-generation HIP and core runtime systems software for AMD GPUs. The work spans compiler runtimes, device-driver interface libraries, and low-level GPU firmware. THE PERSON: This role is for a deeply technical systems generalist who enjoys working across abstraction layers where software meets hardware. You will not only understand how to write correct and performant software with an eye towards memory safety, but you will also have a deep understanding of the interaction with the hardware and firmware architecture to drive co-design. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in at least one part of this stack and the ability to become productive in unfamiliar areas. Experience with every technology listed below is not expected. The ability to read technical work, form testable hypotheses, and turn promising ideas into reliable implementations is valuable. The work sits at the intersection of AI graph frameworks, GPU compiler runtimes, Rust systems programming, GPU architecture, and firmware. Hardware-software co-design experience is highly valuable, especially when runtime, firmware, or ISA choices must evolve together. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Design and implement production-quality Rust components for low-level and performance-sensitive GPU systems. Design and implement distributed runtime components spanning device, host, and firmware for graph execution on AMD GPUs. Build analyses, transformations, legalization passes, and target-specific lowering for GPU execution models, memory spaces, synchronization, capabilities, and specialized hardware operations. Use testing, fuzzing, property-based testing, differential execution, executable models, and hardware validation to find semantic gaps and prevent regressions. Partner with compiler, runtime, firmware, architecture, validation, security, and performance teams to solve problems that cross organizational and technical boundaries. Write design documents, lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and explain complex language, compiler, and hardware behavior clearly. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Strong production Rust experience, including ownership and borrowing, lifetimes, traits and generics, error handling, concurrency, FFI, and the careful design of safe abstractions over unsafe operations. Strong C and C++ systems programming skills and the ability to work across mixed-language codebases. Experience with HIP/CUDA graphs and core GPU runtime principles. Experience with linkers, loaders, ELF or other object formats, code-object metadata, DWARF, or disassembly. Understanding of GPU execution models, including waves or warps, SIMD/SIMT execution, address spaces, registers, local or shared memory, caches, synchronization, atomics, barriers, and asynchronous operations. Strong validation instincts, including adversarial testing, differential testing, property-based testing, fuzzing, reproducible evidence, and careful treatment of assumptions and counterexamples. Hardware-software co-design experience for ISA features, compiler-visible architecture, memory systems, synchronization, security mechanisms, or specialized compute pipelines. PREFERRED ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Research publications and advanced degrees are welcome but are not required. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-G11 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
